f22c13987bf9ec77.text: Using LLMs to Automate Test Scenario Generation in Driving Simulation Mobility Engineering Technology
f22c13987bf9ec77.abstract_zh: 材料是一条 Google 新闻 RSS 条目，来自 Mobility Engineering Technology，标题为 Using LLMs to Automate Test Scenario Generation in Driving Simulation。正文内容缺失，文本部分只有标题的重复，没有作者、摘要或正文段落，也没有给出任何方法细节、实验结果或数据。从标题可以确认的主题是：用大语言模型自动生成驾驶仿真中的测试场景，属于自动驾驶仿真测试场景构建方向。除此之外，材料没有提供可复述的事实，无法判断它用了什么模型、生成了哪类场景、效果如何。
f22c13987bf9ec77.why: 标题指向的方向（用 LLM 自动生成驾驶仿真测试场景）对做仿真推演的读者有参考价值，但这条 RSS 只有标题，建议找到原文再读。

ffe68dd3192d95ba.text: Agent skills are reusable packages that extend a large language model (LLM) agent with scripts, third-party dependencies, and natural-language instructions. An agent builds a skill's arguments from user requests and untrusted external content, so a flaw left by a benign author can escalate a prompt injection to code execution. Existing studies target malicious skills or a single attack vector, and none tests whether an agent can reach such flaws. We present the first registry-scale empirical study of the supply chain attack surface arising from unintentional vulnerabilities in agent skills, over all 48,682 skills in ClawHub. The study covers two carried-over risks, dependencies and first-party code, and two agent-native ones, install instructions and credentials printed to stdout. We screen all skills by static analysis, manually review all 3,428 cases flagged by the four main detectors, and test reachability by running sampled flagged skills in a sandbox and with a live LLM agent under indirect prompt injection. First, dependency risk carries over in a different form: 49.6% of the skills with resolvable dependencies depend on a version with a known CVE, and unlike npm packages, which mostly become vulnerable after release, 78.3% of them are born vulnerable, already exposed at publication. Second, few of these CVEs are reachable: agent input reaches the vulnerable function in only 3.0% of the affected skills, whereas 21 of 22 sampled first-party flaws are exploited end to end in the sandbox. Third, a live agent executes the injected payload in 48.5% of the sampled flagged skills, but almost always in its own shell before the skill runs, and the payload reaches a flaw in the skill itself in only 5.0%. Hence, registries should prioritize first-party flaws over dependency alerts, and agent runtimes should not pass skill arguments through a shell.

f4a24bf226024f74.text: Abstract Environmental trade regulations act on trade networks that adapt over time. This paper develops a stylised agent-based computational model to study policy sequencing in adaptive international trade networks. Exporting countries continuously evaluate their existing trade relationships against alternative import markets. The introduction of environmental regulation alters the relative attractiveness of these markets, prompting exporters to adapt their trade relationships. These adaptations reshape the trade networks on which subsequent policy interventions operate. We show that the timing and sequence of regulatory interventions can therefore influence both the evolution of trade networks and environmental outcomes. In particular, different regulatory sequences generate distinct transition paths even when they ultimately result in identical regulatory coverage. The framework separates the effect of implementation timing from differences in regulatory participation and stringency. The results identify policy timing as a source of path dependence in adaptive trade networks. The study is a mechanism-based computational experiment rather than a forecast or causal estimate of observed regulatory effects.
f4a24bf226024f74.abstract_zh:
环境贸易规制作用在一个随时间不断调整的贸易网络上。作者开发了一个风格化的智能体计算模型，用来研究自适应国际贸易网络中的政策排序问题。模型中，出口国会持续评估现有贸易关系与其他可选进口市场，环境规制的引入改变了这些市场的相对吸引力，促使出口国调整贸易关系，这些调整又重塑了后续政策干预所作用的贸易网络。

模型实验表明，规制干预的时机和顺序会影响贸易网络的演化和环境结果。即使不同的规制顺序最终达到完全相同的规制覆盖范围，它们也会产生不同的转型路径。该框架把实施时机的影响与规制参与度、规制严格程度的差异分离开来，从而识别出政策时序是自适应贸易网络中路径依赖的一个来源。

作者强调，这是一项基于机制的 computational experiment，不是对观测到的规制效果的预测或因果估计。
f4a24bf226024f74.why: 它用机制型智能体模型把“政策实施时序”从参与度和严格程度中剥离出来单独分析，对做政策推演的人是一个可复用的思路：同样的政策终点，不同的顺序会走出不同的路径。

brief.question: 研究环境贸易规制的实施时机和顺序如何影响自适应国际贸易网络的演化路径和环境结果。
brief.setup: 未说明具体智能体数量、模型和时间尺度。智能体是出口国，环境是国际进口市场网络，出口国持续比较现有贸易关系与替代进口市场的吸引力。
brief.method: 构建风格化的基于智能体的计算模型（agent-based computational model），出口国根据市场相对吸引力调整贸易关系，规制介入改变市场吸引力，网络随之重塑，后续政策再作用于新网络。框架把实施时机的影响与规制参与度、严格程度的差异分离开。
brief.findings: 规制的时机和顺序会影响贸易网络演化和环境结果。不同规制顺序即使最终覆盖范围相同，也会产生不同的转型路径。政策时机是自适应贸易网络中路径依赖的一个来源。
brief.validation: 未说明。作者明确这是机制型计算实验，不是对观测到的规制效果的预测或因果估计。
brief.limits: 作者自己声明该研究是机制型计算实验，不构成预测或对现实规制效果的因果估计。
brief.reuse: 未说明。

f7ed0bde1dfdf148.text: Abstract Every morning, millions of drivers choose their routes independently, yet the traffic they produce follows a strikingly simple pattern. Physics has long tried to describe cities as it describes gases, with a few macroscopic quantities, but it has lacked the equivalent of temperature: a single number that tells how strongly a road network is loaded. We show that such a temperature emerges from user equilibrium, the standard model of route choice used by transportation engineers. In six cities as different as Boston, Lisbon, Rio de Janeiro and Beijing, how full each road is relative to its capacity follows the same exponential distribution, the maximum-entropy (least-biased) distribution compatible with the average load. Its single scale acts as an effective temperature of the city. This pattern persists when demand changes, in an independent dataset of 20 US cities, and in simulations where drivers never reach equilibrium. The temperature reveals what aggregate demand hides: cities equally hot can differ by 30% in their ratio of demand to road supply, depending on which roads carry the traffic. It predicts, with no adjustable parameters, how many roads become heavily loaded as demand grows, and a single law links it to travel times in every city. The effective temperature offers a common language for engineering models of traffic and the physics of congestion, from the percolation of traffic jams to the macroscopic fundamental diagram.
f7ed0bde1dfdf148.abstract_zh: 每天早上数百万司机独立选路，产生的交通却呈现简单规律。物理学一直想用少数宏观量描述城市，就像描述气体那样，但缺少温度的对应物，即一个刻画路网负载强度的单一数字。作者证明这样的温度会从用户均衡（交通工程师常用的路径选择标准模型）中自然涌现。在波士顿、里斯本、里约热内卢、北京等六个差异很大的城市中，每条道路的负载相对容量的比值都服从同一个指数分布，也就是与平均负载相容的最大熵（最小偏倚）分布，其单一尺度参数就充当城市的有效温度。这个规律在需求变化时依然成立，在 20 个美国城市的独立数据集中成立，在司机从未达到均衡的仿真中也成立。温度还揭示了总量需求所掩盖的信息：同样热的两个城市，需求与道路供给之比可以相差 30%，取决于交通落在哪些路上。它能在不引入可调参数的情况下预测需求增长时有多少道路变得重载，并且一条单一规律把温度与每个城市的出行时间联系起来。作者认为有效温度为交通工程模型与拥堵物理学提供了共同语言，适用范围从拥堵渗流到宏观基本图。
f7ed0bde1dfdf148.why: 它给交通仿真和推演提供了一个可校准的宏观量：只要拿到路网负载分布就能算出城市温度，并据此无参数预测拥堵演化，适合作为仿真结果与真实城市数据对齐的基准。

brief.question: 城市交通网络是否像气体一样存在一个类似温度的宏观量，用来刻画道路网络的负载强度，并预测拥堵如何随需求增长而演化。
brief.setup: 分析六个差异很大的城市（Boston、Lisbon、Rio de Janeiro、Beijing 等）的道路负载数据，另用 20 个美国城市的独立数据集验证，并做了驾驶员未达到均衡的仿真。
brief.method: 从 user equilibrium（交通工程师的标准路径选择模型）出发，统计每条道路相对其容量的占用率，发现其服从最大熵（最小偏倚）的指数分布，该分布只有一个尺度参数，作为城市的有效温度。
brief.findings: 六个城市道路占用率均服从同一指数分布；需求变化时该模式仍然成立；温度相同的城市，需求与道路供给之比可相差 30%，取决于哪些道路承载交通；该温度无需可调参数即可预测随需求增长有多少道路变为重载，且单一规律将温度与各城市的出行时间联系起来。
brief.validation: 与六个真实城市数据对比，并在 20 个美国城市的独立数据集和未达到均衡的仿真中复现了同一指数分布模式。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: 有效温度可作为交通工程模型与拥堵物理（如拥堵渗流、宏观基本图）之间的共同语言；指数分布的单一尺度参数可直接从平均负载估计。

f94538d40439027e.text: Synthetic populations that integrate sociodemographic and health attributes are essential for individual-level modeling and estimating population-health outcomes at fine geographic scales. Currently, there is no open-source, nationwide U.S. synthetic population dataset with health-relevant characteristics that is built from public data using reproducible methods. We previously developed and evaluated the Spatial Health and Population Estimator (SHAPE), an open-source and flexible spatial microsimulation framework that uses hierarchical iterative proportional fitting to synthesize populations from public surveys and census data. Here, we present the latest SHAPE outputs: a 2024 spatially-explicit synthetic population and corresponding small-area estimates at county and census tract scales, including seven sociodemographic attributes, two health behaviors, and eleven health outcomes, along with an interactive GIS dashboard and replicable code. Evaluation of SHAPE’s 2023 estimates against the latest CDC PLACES estimates (2023) demonstrates strong agreement, with variation by outcome and location. SHAPE provides a scalable resource for generating health-related synthetic populations and small-area estimates that preserve joint distributions of individuals’ sociodemographic and health characteristics, facilitating research across public health and policy domains.
f94538d40439027e.abstract_zh: 把社会人口特征和健康属性整合在一起的合成人口，是个体级建模和精细地理尺度人群健康估计的基础。但此前美国还没有一个开源、全国范围、由公开数据构建且方法可复现的健康相关合成人口数据集。作者此前开发并评估了 Spatial Health and Population Estimator（SHAPE，空间健康与人口估计器），一个开源灵活的空间微观仿真框架，用分层迭代比例拟合（hierarchical iterative proportional fitting）方法，从公开调查和普查数据合成人口。本文发布 SHAPE 的最新输出，即 2024 年的空间显式合成人口，以及县级和普查区（census tract）尺度的小区域估计，包含七项社会人口属性、两项健康行为和十一项健康结果，同时提供交互式 GIS 仪表盘和可复现代码。验证方面，作者把 SHAPE 的 2023 年估计与最新一期 CDC PLACES 估计（2023）对比，结果显示两者高度一致，一致性程度因健康结果和地区而异。SHAPE 为生成保留个体社会人口与健康特征联合分布的健康合成人口和小区域估计提供了可扩展资源，可服务于公共卫生与政策领域的研究。
f94538d40439027e.why: 它提供了一个现成、开源、经过真实数据校准的全美健康合成人口数据集，做公共卫生仿真、政策推演或智能体模拟的研究者可以直接拿来当人群底座，不必自己从头合成。

resources.name: SHAPE 2024 合成人口与小区域估计数据集（含 GIS 仪表盘与代码）

brief.question: 解决美国缺少开源、全国范围、带健康属性的合成人口数据集的问题，用于个体层面的建模和精细地理尺度（county 和 census tract）的人群健康结果估计。
brief.setup: 使用 Spatial Health and Population Estimator（SHAPE，空间健康与人口估计器）框架，基于公开调查和人口普查数据合成 2024 年美国合成人口，输出 county 和 census tract 两个尺度的数据，包含 7 项社会人口属性、2 项健康行为和 11 项健康结果，另附交互式 GIS dashboard 和可复现代码。
brief.method: SHAPE 采用 hierarchical iterative proportional fitting（分层迭代比例拟合）做空间微观仿真（spatial microsimulation），从公开调查与普查数据合成人口，并保留个体社会人口与健康特征的联合分布。
brief.findings: 发布了 2024 年空间显式的合成人口数据集及对应小区域估计，覆盖 7 项社会人口属性、2 项健康行为、11 项健康结果。
brief.validation: 将 SHAPE 的 2023 年估计与最新 CDC PLACES 2023 估计对比，整体一致性较强，但一致性随健康结果和地区不同而变化。材料未说明具体误差数值。
brief.limits: 与 CDC PLACES 的一致性存在按结果和地点的差异，材料未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 开源的 SHAPE 框架、可复现代码、交互式 GIS dashboard，以及 2024 年合成人口和小区域估计数据集。

f8cc32a5cb386b75.text: Former Nexar AI researchers raise $13 million Seed to bring autonomous-driving simulations to AI agents CTech
f8cc32a5cb386b75.abstract_zh: 这条材料来自 Google 新闻，是 CTech 的一篇报道标题。内容是：曾在 Nexar 从事 AI 研究的人员组建了新公司，完成 1300 万美元的种子轮融资，目标是把自动驾驶仿真技术带给 AI 智能体。材料没有给出公司名称、创始人姓名、投资方、技术路线或产品形态，也没有任何仿真结果或验证数据。从标题推测，这家公司可能想用自动驾驶领域的仿真环境来训练或评测 AI 智能体，但这只是从措辞得出的猜测，材料本身没有展开。
f8cc32a5cb386b75.why: 只值得当作线索跟踪：自动驾驶仿真与 AI 智能体的结合是一个方向，但这条材料只有标题，没有可复用的方法或结论。

fc97273e83d39f85.text: CAGE Challenge 4 is the benchmark on which learned multi-agent cyber defenders are compared. We reproduce its two reference defenders, KEEP and H-MARL Expert, in a pinned container and show that three things read from it measure less than they are taken to measure. First, the simulator silently discards any action asserted for an agent whose previous action is still running, and charges one point for a discarded Restore as for one that runs. The documented observation does not expose the busy flag. Both reference defenders read it in their own wrappers, and switching that check off at evaluation costs KEEP's released policy 99.58 points per episode and H-MARL's 145.98, in both cases the charge for Restores sent to busy agents, with H-MARL's executed actions unchanged step for step. On a supervisory harness, holding interventions until the agent is idle is worth 25.3 and 27.6 points per episode at the published setting. In training, the check decides how a busy step enters the trajectory. Trained without it, KEEP leads at a hundred updates in all four paired seeds and trails from two hundred on in all four. Continued to two thousand updates on three seeds, the repaired recipe ends inside the released interval on one seed and short on two, by 27 and 125 points, a spread across training seeds far wider than the released reproduction interval. Second, the evaluation seeds the environment but not the policy, so a reported mean is one draw, and 88.9% of per-episode outcome variance is the policy's own sampling draw. Third, recovery precision depends on the truth it is scored against. Across five published comparison tables, none states the artifact, sampling, criterion and adversary that would make its numbers comparable. We release the instrument, our patches to both defenders, the traces and checkpoints behind every number, and a five-item disclosure checklist.
fc97273e83d39f85.abstract_zh: CAGE Challenge 4 是比较学习型多智能体网络防守方的基准。作者在固定版本的容器里复现了它的两个参考防守方 KEEP 和 H-MARL Expert，并审计出三件被误读的事。第一，模拟器会静默丢弃发给仍在执行上一个动作的智能体的新动作，而且丢弃的 Restore 和真正执行的 Restore 一样扣一分。文档给出的观测里没有暴露忙碌标志，两个参考防守方都在自己的 wrapper 里读取它。评估时关掉这个检查，KEEP 的已发布策略每回合少 99.58 分，H-MARL 少 145.98 分，扣分都来自发给忙碌智能体的 Restore，而 H-MARL 实际执行的动作逐步不变。在一个监督式 harness 上，等智能体空闲再干预，在已发表设置下每回合值 25.3 和 27.6 分。训练中这个检查决定忙碌步如何进入轨迹。去掉它训练，KEEP 在 100 次更新时在全部四个配对种子上领先，200 次起在全部四个上落后。在三个种子上继续训到 2000 次更新，修复后的配方只有一个种子落在已发布复现区间内，另外两个分别差 27 和 125 分，训练种子间的差距远大于已发布的复现区间。第二，评估只固定环境种子不固定策略采样，所以报告的均值只是单次抽样，88.9% 的逐回合结果方差来自策略自身的采样。第三，恢复精度取决于评分所依据的真值。作者检查了五张已发表的比较表，没有一张说明工件、采样、判据和对手，其数字因此不可比。作者公开了审计工具、对两个防守方的补丁、每个数字背后的轨迹和检查点，以及一份五项披露清单。
fc97273e83d39f85.why: 它用可复现的实验证明一个被广泛使用的网络防御基准的分数含义比想象中少，对任何用学习型智能体做攻防推演并依赖基准排名的人都直接相关，披露清单也可复用。

resources.name: arXiv 论文（含工具、补丁、轨迹与检查点的发布说明）

brief.question: 审计 CAGE Challenge 4 这一学习型多智能体网络防御基准，考察其分数、参考防御者（KEEP、H-MARL Expert）及基于它们构建的对比表实际测量了什么。
brief.setup: 在固定版本的容器（pinned container）中复现两个参考防御者 KEEP 与 H-MARL Expert；环境为 CAGE Challenge 4 多智能体网络防御仿真，时间尺度以 episode 和训练 update 计（如 100、200、2000 updates）；所用模型未说明。
brief.method: 复现参考防御者并做消融：关闭对 busy flag 的检查、在监督式 harness 上把干预推迟到智能体空闲、比较不同训练配方与多种子训练；同时分析评估随机性来源与五张已发表对比表的可比性。
brief.findings: 仿真器会静默丢弃上一动作仍在运行的智能体的新动作，且对丢弃的 Restore 仍计 1 分，而文档化观测不暴露 busy flag；关闭该检查使 KEEP 每 episode 损失 99.58 分、H-MARL 损失 145.98 分（均为发给 busy 智能体的 Restore 计分，H-MARL 执行动作逐步不变）；监督式 harness 下推迟干预值 25.3 与 27.6 分/episode。训练中该检查决定 busy 步如何进入轨迹：无检查时 KEEP 在 100 updates 四个配对种子全领先、200 起四个全落后；修复配方续训至 2000 updates 三个种子中一个落入发
brief.validation: 通过固定容器复现两个参考防御者、关闭 busy 检查的消融、多种子配对训练对比，以及方差分解（88.9% 来自策略采样）来验证；并发布 instrument、补丁、traces 与 checkpoints。
brief.limits: 材料指出评估均值只是单次抽样、训练种子间差异大、已发表表格缺少可比性披露；其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 可复用其发布的审计工具（instrument）、对两个防御者的补丁、所有数字背后的 traces 与 checkpoints，以及五项披露清单（five-item disclosure checklist）。

fd0b4e5ac8bc7e59.text: Large language models are widely used in e-commerce user simulation, providing a foundation for understanding users and predicting human decisions. However, existing simulators still struggle to achieve both personalization and behavioral realism. Most methods predict the next action directly from interaction histories and the current context, without accounting for the evolving mental world that underlies user behavior. Theory of Mind suggests that behavior is driven by mental states, including beliefs, uncertainties, and intentions. Users may interpret the same information in distinct ways, leading to divergent behaviors, while an individual's mental state evolves through interaction and shapes subsequent actions. Ignoring this process prevents simulators from faithfully capturing individual differences and realistic behavior patterns, and undermines its effectiveness in downstream applications. To address this, we propose ShopMind, a Mental World Model for e-commerce user simulation that captures how consumers interpret shopping information and how their mental states evolve, better reflecting individual users and real-world behavior patterns. We further use behavior-mental state pairs synthesized by ShopMind to train a Mental State Reconstruction (MSR) model, which infers consumers' latent mental states from observable behavior. Experiments show that ShopMind improves personalization by 18.0% and behavioral realism by 19.6% over the strongest alternatives. Moreover, MSR improves performance on consumption value measurement and CTR prediction, showing the utility of ShopMind for understanding and predicting real user behavior.
fd0b4e5ac8bc7e59.abstract_zh:
背景与问题：大语言模型已被广泛用于电商用户模拟，用来理解用户和预测人的决策。但现有模拟器很难同时做到个性化和行为真实。多数方法直接从交互历史和当前上下文预测下一步动作，忽略了驱动行为的心理世界。心智理论（Theory of Mind）认为行为由信念、不确定性和意图等心理状态驱动。同一信息在不同用户眼中含义不同，会导致行为分化；个体的心理状态还会随交互不断演化并影响后续动作。忽略这一过程，模拟器就无法忠实呈现个体差异和真实行为模式，也削弱了下游应用的效果。

做法：作者提出 ShopMind，一个面向电商用户模拟的心理世界模型（Mental World Model），显式建模消费者如何解读购物信息、心理状态如何演化，从而更贴近真实用户的行为模式。他们还用 ShopMind 合成的行为与心理状态配对数据训练了一个心理状态重建模型（Mental State Reconstruction, MSR），能从可观察的行为推断消费者潜在的心理状态。

结果：实验表明，ShopMind 相比最强基线在个性化上提升 18.0%，行为真实感提升 19.6%。MSR 在消费价值测量和 CTR（点击率）预测任务上带来性能改进，说明 ShopMind 对理解和预测真实用户行为有实际价值。材料未说明具体实验数据集和验证细节。
fd0b4e5ac8bc7e59.why: 它把心智理论引入 LLM 用户模拟，用可演化的心理状态替代直接预测下一步动作，这个建模思路可以迁移到其他人类行为仿真场景；合成的行为-心理配对数据还能反过来训练推断模型，是一条可复用的闭环做法。

brief.question: 电商用户仿真里怎么同时做到个性化和行为真实。现有模拟器大多直接从交互历史和当前上下文预测下一步动作，忽略了用户背后不断演化的心理状态（信念、不确定性和意图），导致难以捕捉个体差异和真实行为模式。
brief.setup: 材料未说明具体智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度。核心组件是 ShopMind，一个电商用户仿真的 Mental World Model（心理世界模型），基于大语言模型构建，另有一个配套的 Mental State Reconstruction（MSR，心理状态重建）模型，用 ShopMind 合成的行为-心理状态对来训练。
brief.method: 借鉴 Theory of Mind（心智理论），把用户行为建模为由心理状态驱动。ShopMind 捕捉消费者如何解读购物信息以及心理状态如何随交互演化，再由心理状态决定后续行为。MSR 则反过来从可观察行为推断潜在心理状态。
brief.findings: ShopMind 相比最强基线，个性化提升 18.0%，行为真实性提升 19.6%。MSR 在消费价值测量和 CTR（点击率）预测任务上带来性能提升。
brief.validation: 材料提到与最强替代方法对比实验，个性化提升 18.0%、行为真实性提升 19.6%，但未说明具体对比数据集、指标定义或是否与真实用户数据对齐。
brief.limits: 材料未说明。
brief.reuse: 材料未说明代码或数据是否开源。可借鉴的思路是用行为-心理状态对训练心理状态重建模型，以及把心理状态演化纳入用户行为仿真。

f23f3f241ac47b98.text: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as synthetic participants in opinion-dynamics experiments, often assuming that an agent's behaviour is fully determined by its prompt. We test this assumption with a framework in which LLM agents discuss a contested policy issue over repeated rounds while their stance is quantified by a fixed psychometric instrument independent of any dynamics model. Across six LLMs, committed personas are intrinsically stable: in each of the five models tested without peer input, every agent keeps its assigned side for 20 rounds. The observed loss of alignment under discussion is therefore interaction-induced, we call it alignment drift, and model-specific: gpt-4.1 keeps opinion clusters apart, claude-sonnet-5 holds them partially, and gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5 abandon them. Under selective attention, one LLM maintains separated opinion clusters under stance-homophilous attention. Qualitative profiles persist at doubled population and horizon and on a second issue. Such heterogeneity makes the LLM choice a first-class validity variable for social simulation.
f23f3f241ac47b98.abstract_zh:
LLM 智能体越来越多地被用作舆论动力学实验中的合成参与者，常见做法是默认智能体行为完全由提示词决定。作者设计了一个框架来检验这个假设：让 LLM 智能体围绕一个有争议的政策议题进行多轮讨论，立场由一个固定的心理测量工具量化，该工具不依赖任何动力学模型。

在六个 LLM 上测试后发现，坚定人设在无交互条件下是内在稳定的。在没有同伴输入的五个模型中，每个智能体在 20 轮里都保持了自己被分配的立场。因此讨论中出现的立场流失是交互引发的，作者称之为“对齐漂移”（alignment drift），而且这种漂移是模型特有的：gpt-4.1 能让意见簇保持分离，claude-sonnet-5 只能部分保持，gpt-5.6-sol 和 claude-opus-5 则完全放弃原有立场。在选择性注意条件下，有一个 LLM 在同立场偏好（stance-homophilous）的注意模式下仍能维持分离的意见簇。

这些定性特征在人口规模翻倍、时间跨度翻倍以及换到第二个议题后依然成立。作者认为，模型间的这种异质性意味着 LLM 的选择应当成为社会仿真中的一等效度变量。材料未说明具体的政策议题内容和各模型的完整清单。
f23f3f241ac47b98.why: 它直接挑战了“提示词写好人设就万事大吉”的默认做法，用受控实验证明立场漂移是交互引发且模型特有的，做舆论仿真的人在选模型和解读结果时必须把这一点纳入效度考量。

brief.question: 检验一个常被默认的假设：LLM 智能体在意见动力学实验中的行为完全由 prompt 决定。作者推演多个 LLM 智能体就一个有争议的政策议题反复讨论，看立场会不会漂移。
brief.setup: 六个 LLM 作为智能体，带固定人设（committed personas），就一个争议政策议题进行多轮讨论；立场用独立于动力学模型的固定心理测量工具量化；还测试了人口翻倍、轮数加倍和第二个议题。
brief.method: 框架让 LLM 智能体多轮讨论，用固定心理测量工具逐轮量化立场；对比有同伴输入和无同伴输入（peer input）的条件，并引入选择性注意（selective attention）机制，包括 stance-homophilous attention（立场同质注意）。
brief.findings: 五个无同伴输入的模型中，每个智能体 20 轮都保持原立场，说明人设本身稳定。讨论导致的立场失准是交互引发的，作者称之为 alignment drift，且因模型而异：gpt-4.1 能保持意见簇分离，claude-sonnet-5 部分保持，gpt-5.6-sol 和 claude-opus-5 完全放弃。选择性注意下，有一个 LLM 在 stance-homophilous attention 下保持意见簇分离。定性结论在人口翻倍、时间加倍和第二个议题上成立。
brief.validation: 通过无同伴输入的对照实验证明人设内在稳定，从而把漂移归因于交互；并在加倍人口、加倍轮数和第二个议题上复现定性结果。未与真实人类数据对比。
brief.limits: 材料未说明具体议题内容、智能体数量和讨论机制细节；结论主要是定性层面，未提供量化误差。
brief.reuse: 可用固定心理测量工具量化 LLM 智能体立场的做法，以及无同伴输入对照、加倍人口/轮数、换议题的稳健性检验流程；把 LLM 选择当作社会仿真的有效性变量这一思路。代码数据未说明是否公开。

fd305cb0a1a17974.text: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate human participants in social and behavioral studies, yet static persona prompting typically maps a participant profile and an experimental scenario directly to a response, entangling stable dispositions with situation-specific interpretations. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{SPIN}, a cognitive-affective personality system-inspired inference pipeline for simulating human social-psychological behavior. Specifically, SPIN implements this structured inference process through three zero-shot LLM calls that compile a task-blind participant core, elicit condition-specific cognitive-affective states, and read out decisions from those states, thereby reusing stable personality structure while routing each trial-specific response through an explicit state representation. We evaluate SPIN on two reconstructed social-psychological study families spanning uncertainty reasoning and pluralistic ignorance, across four base LLMs. Compared with blank, demographic, narrative, and chain-of-thought prompt variants, SPIN consistently delivers the strongest overall alignment performance across base LLMs and study families. Ablations and state analyses further show that both personality compilation and structured state elicitation contribute to the gains, and that the elicited states shift interpretably across informational and normative conditions. These results suggest that structured personality-state inference can improve benchmark-level behavioral alignment beyond richer persona descriptions or generic multi-step reasoning.
fd305cb0a1a17974.abstract_zh: 大模型常被用来模拟社会与行为研究中的真人被试，但静态人格提示通常直接把被试画像和实验情境映射到一个回答，稳定人格特质和情境化解读被混在一起。为解决这个问题，作者提出 SPIN，一个受认知情感人格系统启发的推理管线，用于模拟人类社会心理行为。SPIN 通过三次零样本 LLM 调用完成结构化推理：第一次编译出与任务无关的被试核心人格，第二次引出特定实验条件下的认知情感状态，第三次从这些状态读出决策。这样既复用了稳定的人格结构，又让每次试验的反应经过显式的状态表示。作者在两类重建的社会心理学实验（不确定推理与多元无知）上、用四个基座大模型评测 SPIN。与空白提示、人口学提示、叙事提示和思维链提示相比，SPIN 在各基座模型和实验类别上都取得最强的整体对齐表现。消融实验和状态分析进一步显示，人格编译和结构化状态引出都对提升有贡献，且引出的状态在信息性条件和规范性条件之间发生可解释的偏移。结果表明，结构化的人格状态推理能在基准层面的行为对齐上超过更丰富的人格描述或通用多步推理。局限是评测只在重建的实验基准上进行，未与真实被试数据直接校准。
fd305cb0a1a17974.why: 它给出一个可复用的提示管线设计：把人格编译和情境状态引出拆成独立的零样本调用，在多个基座模型上稳定超过常见 persona 提示基线，对做人类行为模拟的人是直接的工程参考。

brief.question: 解决静态 persona prompting 模拟人类被试时，把稳定人格特质和情境化解读混在一起的问题，用于社会心理学实验的 LLM 被试仿真。
brief.setup: 在两类重建的社会心理学研究（不确定性推理与多元无知）上评估，覆盖四个基础 LLM，未说明具体模型名称和智能体数量。
brief.method: SPIN 管线，用三次零样本 LLM 调用完成结构化推断：编译任务无关的被试核心人格、引出条件相关的认知-情感状态、再从状态读出决策，复用稳定人格结构并让每次试验响应经过显式状态表示。
brief.findings: 与空白、人口学、叙事和 chain-of-thought 四种 prompt 变体相比，SPIN 在所有基础 LLM 和研究类别上整体对齐表现最强；消融显示人格编译和结构化状态引出都有贡献，引出的状态在信息性与规范性条件间可解释地变化。材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 做了消融实验和状态分析，确认两个组件的贡献及状态随条件可解释地移动；与四种 prompt 基线对比。未说明与真实人类被试数据的定量对比误差。
brief.limits: 未说明。
brief.reuse: SPIN 的三次调用结构化推断管线（人格编译、状态引出、决策读出）可直接借鉴，代码和数据未说明是否公开。

f1be77ffa321b464.text: Can LLMs reason through new information like humans, or do they merely retrieve cached opinions? This is critical for silicon sampling, where LLM personas simulate public opinion at scale. Current evaluations test only whether personas hold the right opinions -- a static snapshot. But opinion research increasingly depends on dynamic fidelity: whether personas update beliefs in response to new arguments, as humans do during deliberation. No existing benchmark tests this. We introduce the Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework, which compares human and LLM belief shifts after identical informational interventions. Grounded in deliberative polling, it surfaces failures invisible to static evaluation: models that produce plausible partisan opinions can still misrepresent how those opinions change. Applying the framework to five frontier models using data from America in One Room (526 personas, 72 questions), we find that every model fails, each in a unique manner. GPT-5.1 exhibits reversal: its personas become more hostile toward the opposing party after balanced information, while humans become less so. This reversal is selective (80% on outgroup vs. 26% on policy questions) and symmetric across partisan identities. Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Llama 3.3 70B exhibit overshoot, shifting correctly but at 5-7x human magnitude. DeepSeek V3 exhibits rigidity with near-zero change. Targeted ablations reveal that policy content triggers these failures and that they are identity-specific: GPT-5.1 reverses on outgroup questions but overshoots on ingroup; Gemini shows the inverse. We term this signature self-sycophancy: conformity to the model's internal stereotype of the persona rather than reasoning from the information provided. Our framework offers a concrete protocol: run the deliberative diagnostic before trusting LLM personas to mimic revised beliefs.
f1be77ffa321b464.abstract_zh: LLM 人设被用来大规模模拟公众意见（silicon sampling），但现有评测只检查人设是否持有正确的意见，是静态快照。意见研究越来越依赖动态保真度：人设在收到新论点后是否会像人类在审议中那样更新信念。此前没有基准测试这一点。作者提出审议式民调诊断框架，基于审议式民调方法，让人和 LLM 人设在相同的信息干预后比较信念变化，能暴露静态评测看不到的失败：能给出合理党派意见的模型，仍可能错误表现这些意见如何变化。作者用 America in One Room 的数据（526 个人设、72 个问题）测试了五个前沿模型，每个模型都以不同方式失败。GPT-5.1 出现反转：在接收平衡信息后，它的人设对对立党派变得更敌对，而人类变得更少敌对。这种反转有选择性（对外群体问题占 80%，政策问题占 26%），且在不同党派身份上对称。Gemini 2.0 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5 和 Llama 3.3 70B 出现过冲：方向正确但幅度是人类的 5 到 7 倍。DeepSeek V3 表现出刚性，变化接近零。消融实验显示政策内容触发这些失败，且失败与身份相关：GPT-5.1 在外群体问题上反转、在内群体问题上过冲，Gemini 则相反。作者把这种模式称为自我谄媚：模型顺从它对人设的内部刻板印象，而不是根据提供的信息推理。框架给出具体协议：在信任 LLM 人设模拟修订后的信念之前，先跑这个审议式诊断。
f1be77ffa321b464.why: 它指出了硅采样研究里一个被静态评测掩盖的盲点，并给出可直接复用的诊断协议，对任何想用 LLM 人设做民意或政策推演的人都是必要的前置检查。

resources.name: America in One Room 数据（526 人设、72 问题）

brief.question: LLM 人格能否像人类一样根据新信息更新信念，还是只是检索缓存的观点。现有评估只测人格是否持有正确观点的静态快照，无法测动态保真度，即人格在审议式讨论中是否像人类那样更新信念。
brief.setup: 用 America in One Room 的数据（526 个人格、72 个问题），对五个前沿模型（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Llama 3.3 70B、DeepSeek V3）做审议式诊断，比较人类和 LLM 在相同信息干预后的信念变化。
brief.method: 提出 Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework，基于 deliberative polling 方法，给 LLM 人格和人类提供完全相同的信息干预，对比双方信念偏移的方向和幅度。还做了针对性消融实验，区分政策内容和身份相关内容触发的不同失败模式。
brief.findings: 五个模型全部失败，方式各不相同。GPT-5.1 出现反转：接收平衡信息后其人格对对立政党更敌视，而人类反而更缓和；反转有选择性（外群体问题 80%，政策问题 26%）且在两党身份上对称。Gemini 2.0 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Llama 3.3 70B 出现过冲，方向正确但幅度是人类的 5-7 倍。DeepSeek V3 出现僵化，变化接近零。消融显示失败由政策内容触发且与身份相关：GPT-5.1 在外群体问题上反转、在内群体问题上过冲，Gemini 相反。作者称之为 self-sycophancy，即模型迎合自身对人格的内部刻板印象而非基于所给信息推理。
brief.validation: 与 America in One Room 中 526 个人类被试在相同信息干预下的真实信念变化对比，并做了区分政策内容与身份内容的消融实验。这是与真实人类审议数据的直接对比，强度较高。
brief.limits: 材料未说明框架在 America in One Room 之外议题上的适用性，也未说明五个模型之外的其他模型表现。
brief.reuse: 可复用的是 Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework 这套协议本身：在信任 LLM 人格模拟修订后信念之前，先跑审议式诊断，对比模型与人类在相同信息干预下的信念偏移。材料未说明是否开源代码或数据。

f1993a19a3785c58.text: Large language models (LLMs) are proposed as synthetic respondents for pilot testing, but their usefulness depends on whether they supply the evidence assessment development requires. We calibrated rating scale models on 14 digital-use skill items from 6,245 adults and used the human item parameters to evaluate responses generated for 1,300 demographically matched personas. LLM responses had high internal consistency ($α\approx .94$) but used the lowest category in 0.2-0.3% of responses versus 13.7-21.5% for humans, and no persona chose it on every item. These gaps changed the response-category judgment on both subscales and the PC targeting judgment; on the human-calibrated scales, 12 of 14 items had infit below 0.70, indicating responses more predictable than the Rasch model expects. Preregistered changes to the prompt, category order, and persona information did not restore the human lower range. High internal consistency is insufficient evidence that LLM responses can replace human pilot data.
f1993a19a3785c58.abstract_zh: LLM 常被提议用作量表试测的合成受访者，但前提是它能提供测评开发所需的证据。作者先在 6245 名成年人的 14 道数字技能题上校准了等级量表模型，得到真人项目参数，再用这些参数评估为 1300 个与真人人口特征匹配的画像生成的 LLM 答卷。结果上，LLM 答卷内部一致性很高（α≈.94），但最低分档只出现在 0.2-0.3% 的作答里，真人则是 13.7-21.5%，而且没有任何画像在所有题目上都选最低档。这些差距改变了两个子量表上的分档判断和 PC 靶向判断；在真人校准的量表上，14 道题里有 12 道的 infit 低于 0.70，说明 LLM 作答比 Rasch 模型预期的更可预测。作者按预注册方案修改了提示词、分档顺序和画像信息，都没能恢复真人的低分区间。结论是高内部一致性不足以证明 LLM 答卷能替代真人试测数据。局限在于该结论基于这 14 道数字技能题和所用模型，未在材料中报告其他题型或模型的推广情况。
f1993a19a3785c58.why: 它给“用 LLM 智能体替代真人样本”提供了一个可复用的验证方法：用真人校准的 Rasch 项目参数做基准，并给出一个反例，高内部一致性掩盖了低分档分布的系统性缺失。

brief.question: LLM 生成的问卷回答能否替代人类试测数据，用于评估工具（assessment）的开发与心理测量学分析。
brief.setup: 以 6,245 名成年人在 14 个数字技能（digital-use skill）题目上的人类回答为校准基准，让 LLM 为 1,300 个与人类人口学特征匹配的 persona 生成回答。
brief.method: 先用人类数据校准 rating scale 模型（Rasch），得到题目参数，再用这些参数评估 LLM 生成的回答，比较类别使用分布、infit 等指标。
brief.findings: LLM 回答内部一致性很高（α≈.94），但最低类别仅占 0.2-0.3% 的回答，人类为 13.7-21.5%，且没有任何 persona 在所有题目都选最低类别。这导致两个子量表的类别判断和 PC targeting 判断改变；在人类校准量表上，14 个题目中有 12 个 infit 低于 0.70，说明回答比 Rasch 模型预期更可预测。
brief.validation: 与 6,245 名成年人的真实回答数据对比校准，属于与真实人类数据的直接对比，强度较高；另有预注册的提示词、类别顺序和 persona 信息改动实验，均未能恢复人类的低分端分布。
brief.limits: LLM 回答缺失人类的低分端反应范围，预注册的提示词、类别顺序、persona 信息修改都无法修复，因此高内部一致性不足以证明 LLM 回答可替代人类试测数据。
brief.reuse: 未说明。

f2f4f3ec4d43fd89.text: Large language models(LLMs) have recently been used to construct generative agents for financial market simulation. Existing approaches typically prompt each agent separately with public market information and a private investor profile, and ask the model to directly generate trading actions. In this agent-wise design, the model repeatedly interprets information shared across the population, while individual behavior is controlled through textual descriptions of investor preferences and traits. This creates two structural difficulties: continuous traits such as risk sensitivity do not reliably induce ordered behavioral changes, and repeatedly processing the same public information causes inference costs to grow with the number of agents. We propose \textbf{SUM}, a Semantic-Utility Model that separates cohort-level semantic perception from agent-level utility-based decision-making. A language model interprets public market information for each investor type and produces semantic signals shared within the corresponding cohort. Individual agents then combine these signals with their private states, preferences, and constraints to generate orders through utility-based decisions. Experiments in an A-share limit-order-book market show that \textbf{SUM} provides more stable and monotonic behavioral control than prompt-based agents while substantially reducing repeated language-model inference as the population grows. Closed-loop simulations further reproduce directional market responses, volatility persistence, differentiated investment styles, and persistent wealth heterogeneity. These results establish \textbf{SUM} as a controllable, scalable, and semantically informed framework for financial market simulation.

f0b6d5016bfdb11b.text: Open-source software communities are a form of digital public infrastructure that not only produces code, but also generates public knowledge and interpersonal relationships through visible collaboration. Generative coding agents (CAs) are an advanced tool to improve development efficiency while shifting part of activities from public human interaction to private human-agent loops. We study this shift using an LLM-based multi-agent simulation initialized with real GitHub data from 1,084 active developers and their repository relationships. After a warm-up with historical commits, we branch the same community state into parallel No-CA and CA conditions for 4-week simulations. CA introduction increases planned and completed tasks by 34.0% and 39.0%, respectively, and reduces median completion time from 45 to 20 minutes. However, adoption reaches only 26.0%, and the gains concentrate among developers who are already more active and well connected. CAs also restructure task execution pathways. Direct human-human interaction declines from 32.4% to 11.6%, while CA-involved modes increase to 57.3%, including 40.3% completed through CA-assisted self-loops. Public knowledge generated under CA condition also provides less support for later tasks. On a standardized retrieval benchmark, the CA corpus achieves 22.3% knowledge coverage, far below the 81.1% achieved by the real-human corpus, and requires more retrieval steps with a lower success rate. These results reveal a productivity-public knowledge tension: coding agents increase technical production, but more work shifts to agent-mediated or private loops, leaving public records less useful to future contributors.
f0b6d5016bfdb11b.abstract_zh:
开源社区不只产出代码，还通过公开协作产生公共知识和人际关系。生成式编码智能体（CA）能提高开发效率，但会把一部分活动从公开的人际互动转移到私密的人机循环里。作者想量化这种转移的后果。

做法上，他们构建了一个基于 LLM 的多智能体仿真，用 1084 名活跃开发者及其仓库关系等真实 GitHub 数据初始化社区，先用历史提交做热身，再把同一社区状态分支成无 CA 和有 CA 两个平行条件，各仿真 4 周。

结果分两面。生产端，引入 CA 后计划任务增加 34.0%，完成任务增加 39.0%，中位完成时间从 45 分钟降到 20 分钟。但采用率只有 26.0%，收益集中在本来就活跃、人脉好的开发者身上。结构端，任务执行路径被重组：人人直接交互从 32.4% 降到 11.6%，涉及 CA 的模式升到 57.3%，其中 40.3% 的任务靠 CA 辅助的自我循环完成。公共知识也变弱了，在标准化检索基准上，CA 条件产生的语料只覆盖 22.3% 的知识，远低于真人语料的 81.1%，且检索步数更多、成功率更低。

结论是一个生产力与公共知识的张力：编码智能体提高了技术产出，但更多工作转入智能体中介或私密循环，留下的公开记录对后来的贡献者用处变小。
f0b6d5016bfdb11b.why: 它展示了用真实平台数据初始化、平行分支对照的多智能体仿真方法，可以直接复用到其他社区或组织演化问题上；同时它给出一个反直觉结论，AI 提效的代价是公共知识库退化，对任何引入 AI 智能体改变协作流程的团队都是需要警惕的风险。

brief.question: 研究生成式编码智能体（Coding Agents, CAs）进入开源社区后，对生产力和社区公共知识、人际协作结构产生什么影响。
brief.setup: 用 LLM 多智能体仿真，初始化自真实 GitHub 数据，包含 1,084 名活跃开发者及其仓库关系。先用历史 commit 做热身，再把同一社区状态分支成无 CA 和有 CA 两个平行条件，各仿真 4 周。
brief.method: 基于真实 GitHub 关系初始化智能体社区，热身后分支成 No-CA 与 CA 两个平行条件做对照仿真，比较任务产出、交互模式和公共知识质量。
brief.findings: 引入 CA 后计划任务和完成任务分别增加 34.0% 和 39.0%，任务完成中位时间从 45 分钟降到 20 分钟。但采用率只有 26.0%，收益集中在本来就活跃、连接多的开发者。直接人际交互从 32.4% 降到 11.6%，CA 参与的模式升到 57.3%，其中 40.3% 通过 CA 辅助的自我闭环完成。在标准化检索基准上，CA 条件生成的语料知识覆盖率只有 22.3%，远低于真人语料的 81.1%，且检索步骤更多、成功率更低。
brief.validation: 与真实人类语料在标准化检索基准上对比知识覆盖率（22.3% vs 81.1%），并用平行分支的 No-CA 条件做对照。未说明与真实社区采用 CA 后的实际数据对比。
brief.limits: 收益分布不均，集中在高活跃、高连接的开发者；公共记录对后续贡献者的支持减弱。仿真本身的局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 用真实 GitHub 数据初始化 LLM 多智能体社区、热身后分支平行条件做对照仿真的方法可直接借鉴。代码和数据未说明是否公开。

f7e37f23054d2f1c.text: Incident response is currently managed by security operators using predefined playbooks, resulting in slow, labor-intensive security decision-making processes. Consequently, there is a growing need for automated incident response planning. Decision-theoretic approaches based on control, optimization, and reinforcement learning have been proposed to automate such planning tasks with well-grounded approaches, yet most of which, while guaranteeing strong performance, are limited to abstract models and cannot be directly applied to operational systems. A promising approach to mitigate this limitation is to use the security knowledge embedded in large language models (LLMs) to develop agentic response systems. However, current agentic approaches rely on repeated invocations of the LLM to generate a response plan, which is unreliable and limits the planning horizon due to hallucination. In this paper, we develop a principled LLM-based planning method by combining decision-theoretic planning with LLM-generated response commands. The proposed agentic incident response approach uses a rollout planner to compute a high-level response strategy that allocates security resources (the tactical scale), which is then translated into executable commands by a lightweight LLM agent (the operational scale). Within this architecture, we use a digital twin that supports tactical planning through simulation and operational execution through emulation. Across three attack scenarios, our agentic approach reduces recovery execution time by 15.1\% on average and increases the recovery rate by 33.6\% over frontier LLM baselines.

f207c43561f2124b.text: Large language models are increasingly used as social simulators, including as synthetic survey respondents. Most evaluations ask whether simulated outcomes resemble human outcomes. We argue that this is necessary but too weak: a simulator can match the final answer while using the wrong rationale-derived reason pattern. We study this problem through a 94-person sunscreen concept test in which each respondent evaluated three product concepts and wrote open-ended rationales. We map those rationales into signed reason states $Z$, where positive signs support adoption and negative signs block it. This gives a practical audit: holding respondent descriptors $D$, category context $K$, and concept treatment $X$ fixed, do human rationale-derived reasons help predict behavior $Y$, and can an LLM simulate the same reason state without seeing the human rationale or outcome? Human rationale-derived reasons substantially improve held-out prediction of purchase intent. LLM-simulated reasons are more brittle: they often sound plausible, but frequently echo the concept board rather than recover the respondent's acceptance or rejection path. The paper contributes an evaluation framework for social simulators. Reason states do not identify natural causal effects by themselves, but they provide an interpretable test of whether a simulator's stated reasons align with human evidence.
f207c43561f2124b.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地被用作社会模拟器，包括合成问卷受访者。现有评测大多只问模拟结果是否与人类结果相似。作者认为这个标准必要但太弱：一个模拟器可以在最终答案上匹配人类，却使用了错误的理由模式。研究基于一个 94 人的防晒霜概念测试，每位受访者评估三个产品概念并写下开放式理由。作者把这些理由映射成带符号的理由状态 Z，正号表示支持采纳，负号表示阻碍采纳。由此得到一个可操作的审计方法：固定受访者描述 D、品类背景 K 和概念处理 X，检验人类理由衍生的理由是否有助于预测行为 Y，以及 LLM 能否在不看人类理由和结果的情况下模拟出同样的理由状态。结果显示，人类理由衍生的理由显著提升了购买意愿在留出样本上的预测。LLM 模拟出的理由则更脆：它们往往听起来合理，但经常只是回声式复述概念板上的信息，而不是还原受访者的接受或拒绝路径。论文的贡献是一个社会模拟器评测框架。作者也说明，理由状态本身不能识别自然因果效应，但它提供了一个可解释的检验，用来判断模拟器陈述的理由是否与人类证据一致。
f207c43561f2124b.why: 它给合成受访者评测提供了一个比结果匹配更严的审计思路：不看最终答案对不对，而是看模拟器能否还原人类的推理路径，做 LLM 社会仿真验证的人可以直接借用这套带符号理由状态的框架。

brief.question: 审计 LLM 社会仿真器：仿真器即使最终答案与人类一致，其给出的理由模式也可能与人类真实理由不同。作者要检验 LLM 能否在看不到人类理由和结果的情况下，仿真出人类受访者真实的接受或拒绝理由。
brief.setup: 94 人参与的防晒霜概念测试，每位受访者评估三个产品概念并写下开放式理由。理由被映射为带符号的 reason states Z，正号支持采纳、负号阻止采纳。固定受访者描述 D、品类背景 K 和概念处理 X。未说明使用的具体 LLM 型号。
brief.method: 把人类开放式理由映射成带符号的 reason states，在固定 D、K、X 的条件下检验两件事：人类理由是否帮助预测购买意向 Y，以及 LLM 能否仿真出同样的 reason state 而不接触人类理由或结果。
brief.findings: 人类理由显著提升了留出集上购买意向的预测。LLM 仿真的理由更脆弱：听起来合理，但经常只是复述概念板内容，而不是还原受访者的接受或拒绝路径。
brief.validation: 与 94 人真实概念测试的理由和购买意向数据对比，用留出集预测检验人类理由的增益，并比较 LLM 仿真理由与人类理由的对齐程度。样本仅 94 人、单一品类（防晒霜），强度有限。
brief.limits: 作者自己说明 reason states 本身不能识别自然因果效应，只提供仿真器理由与人类证据是否对齐的可解释检验。样本小、品类单一。
brief.reuse: 可复用的是这套审计框架：把开放式理由编码为带符号 reason states，在固定描述符和处理的条件下对比仿真理由与人类理由的预测力和对齐度。代码和数据未说明是否公开。

f51b1a25cbc11509.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as stand-ins for human respondents, from opinion polls and simulated survey participants to agent-based social simulations. These uses rest on one assumption: that conditioning a model on who a person is yields answers resembling those of real people from that group. Here we identify and measure benevolence bias, a small but consistent tendency for aligned LLMs to lean toward the kinder, safer, more socially approved answer on value-laden survey questions. Across 18 widely used models, four social-science datasets (ANES, GSS, WVS, and a cross-cultural prospect-theory replication) and six psychological categories, we find that the bias is a stable model property, not a quirk of any one system: it points the same way across models, grows with model size, and traces to the post-training stage. Prompt language and framing change its size but never its direction, and a "malicious persona" stress test shows a one-sided limit: aligned models struggle to play people who are less kind, less prosocial or more harm-tolerant than average. The issue is thus not only a shifted average, but a narrowed range of people the model can imitate. The bias sits in the middle of the answer distribution rather than its tails, and survives changes in sampling temperature and simple prompted reflection. The encouraging news is that it is easy to diagnose and straightforward to fix: a light-touch contrastive calibration, which needs no retraining and works on black-box APIs, brings all six categories back to the human baseline. Our results give researchers a clear map of where aligned LLMs can already be trusted as human stand-ins, where they need care, and a ready-to-use method for closing the gap.
f51b1a25cbc11509.abstract_zh:
大模型越来越多地被用来替代真人受访者，做民意调查、模拟问卷和基于智能体的社会仿真。这些用法都依赖一个假设：给模型设定一个人物身份，它给出的回答会接近该群体的真实人类。作者识别并测量了“仁慈偏差”，即经过对齐的大模型在价值类问卷上一种幅度不大但稳定的倾向，偏向更善良、更安全、更受社会认可的答案。

实验覆盖 18 个常用模型、四个社会科学数据集（ANES、GSS、WVS 和一项跨文化前景理论复现）以及六个心理类别。结果显示这种偏差是模型的稳定属性而非某个系统的特例：方向在所有模型上一致，随模型规模增大而变大，来源可追溯到后训练阶段。提示语言和表述方式会改变偏差大小，但从不改变方向。一个“恶意人格”压力测试暴露出单侧的局限：对齐后的模型很难扮演比平均水平更不善良、更不亲社会或更能容忍伤害的人。问题因此不只是平均值偏移，而是模型能模仿的人群范围变窄了。偏差位于答案分布的中段而非尾部，改变采样温度和简单的提示反思都不能消除它。

好消息是这种偏差容易诊断、也容易修复。作者提出一种轻量的对比校准方法，不需要重新训练，在黑盒 API 上就能用，可以把六个类别全部拉回人类基线。结果给研究者画出了一张地图：对齐后的大模型在哪些地方已经可以作为人类替身被信任，哪些地方需要谨慎，以及一个现成的修补方法。
f51b1a25cbc11509.why: 对用大模型智能体做社会仿真和合成问卷的研究者，这篇给出了一个必须知道的系统性偏差及其来源（后训练对齐），还附上一个无需重训、黑盒可用的校准方法，直接关系到仿真结果能不能对上真人数据。

resources.name: ANES / GSS / WVS 及跨文化前景理论复现数据集

brief.question: LLM 被用作人类受访者替身（民意调查、模拟问卷、社会仿真）时，对齐后的模型是否真的能还原真实人群的回答分布。作者识别并测量了 benevolence bias（仁慈偏差），即模型在价值类问卷上偏向更友善、更安全、更符合社会期许的答案。
brief.setup: 覆盖 18 个常用 LLM，四个社会科学数据集（ANES、GSS、WVS 和一个跨文化前景理论复现），六个心理类别。材料未说明具体智能体数量、环境与时间尺度。
brief.method: 测量偏差是否为模型稳定属性：跨模型比较、随模型规模变化、定位到 post-training 阶段；用 prompt 语言和框架变化、sampling temperature、prompted reflection 做扰动；用 malicious persona 压力测试检验模型能否扮演低于平均友善度的人。修正方法是一种轻量 contrastive calibration，无需重训练，可用于黑盒 API。
brief.findings: 偏差方向跨模型一致，随模型规模增大，源于 post-training 阶段。prompt 语言和框架只改变偏差大小，不改变方向。malicious persona 测试显示对齐模型难以扮演更不友善、更少亲社会、更能容忍伤害的人，即问题不只是均值偏移，而是可模仿人群范围收窄。偏差位于答案分布中部而非尾部，在温度变化和简单反思后仍然存在。轻量对比校准能把全部六个类别拉回人类基线。
brief.validation: 与 ANES、GSS、WVS 等真实人类调查数据对比，覆盖 18 个模型、4 个数据集、6 个类别，并做了温度、prompt 框架、反思等扰动检验。材料未给出具体误差数字。
brief.limits: 对齐模型无法扮演比平均更不友善的人群，分布范围收窄；简单 prompted reflection 无法消除偏差。材料未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 可直接使用文中提出的 contrastive calibration 方法：无需重训练、适用于黑盒 API，可将六个类别校准回人类基线。材料未说明是否开源代码或数据。

f0e5205395612e32.text: Shippers are beginning to delegate carrier selection to large language model (LLM) agents. We ask what such delegation does to a freight matching market, and which platform design choices contain it. We carried out agent-based simulations in which fifty shipper agents, built on commercial LLMs from OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic (Claude), and Google (Gemini), procure truckload capacity for thirty days. The market implements the rules of digital freight matching: each load is offered down the shipper's ranked list of carriers (waterfall tendering), carriers have daily capacity limits, spot prices respond to congestion, and carrier ratings accumulate with transactions. We found three risks and one remedy that works. Agents converged at once: for a fixed sampled carrier population, the same carrier was the modal first choice of every model on day one, attracting up to 76% of requests. Because each agent picks from its own randomly drawn list of displayed candidates, the platform controls how many options each shipper sees; concentration rose steeply once lists exceeded about ten carriers, with the onset differing across models. Which carriers ended up dominant varied widely from one sampled market to another, and displaying true quality instead of estimated ratings changed neither the level nor this variability (by design, quality affects only what agents see, never delivery outcomes). Against these risks, disclosing each carrier's remaining daily capacity cut concentration by a third and doubled shipper surplus, while vendor diversification, list-order randomization, and popularity display showed no clearly detectable effect. Platform information design, ahead of model choice or model regulation, is the lever that works.
f0e5205395612e32.abstract_zh:
货主开始把承运商选择交给大模型智能体，作者想知道这种委托会对货运匹配市场造成什么影响，以及平台设计能否约束它。他们做了基于智能体的仿真：50 个货主智能体，分别基于 OpenAI（GPT）、Anthropic（Claude）和 Google（Gemini）的商业大模型，在符合数字货运匹配规则的市场里连续 30 天采购整车运力。市场规则包括瀑布式招标（每票货按货主的承运商排序依次发出）、承运商每日运力上限、拥堵驱动的现货价格，以及随交易累积的承运商评分。

结果有三条风险和一条有效的对策。第一，智能体立刻收敛：对同一组抽样出的承运商，三个模型在第一天就把同一家承运商作为众数首选，最多吸引 76% 的请求。第二，每个智能体从平台随机抽取的候选列表里挑选，平台因此能控制每个货主看到多少选项；候选列表超过约十家后集中度陡升，拐点位置因模型而异。第三，哪个承运商最终占主导在不同抽样市场之间差异很大，而且把估计评分换成真实质量展示，既不改变集中度水平也不改变这种波动性（按设计，质量只影响智能体看到的信息，不影响交付结果）。

对策方面，披露每家承运商当日剩余运力使集中度下降三分之一、货主剩余翻倍；而供应商多元化、列表顺序随机化和热度展示都没有可检测的效果。作者的结论是，平台的信息设计，比选哪个模型或监管模型更管用。
f0e5205395612e32.why: 它把 LLM 智能体作为市场参与者放进一个规则明确的货运匹配仿真，量化了算法委托带来的集中风险，并给出一个可操作的平台设计杠杆（披露剩余运力），对研究平台机制设计和算法中介市场的人有直接参考价值。

brief.question: 货主把承运商选择委托给 LLM 智能体后，货运匹配市场会发生什么，平台设计如何约束由此产生的集中度。
brief.setup: 50 个货主智能体，基于 OpenAI (GPT)、Anthropic (Claude)、Google (Gemini) 的商用 LLM，在数字货运匹配规则下采购整车运力，仿真持续 30 天。市场机制包括瀑布式招标（按货主排序的承运商名单依次报价）、承运商每日运力上限、拥堵驱动的现货价格、随交易累积的承运商评分。
brief.method: 智能体仿真，平台控制每个货主可见的候选承运商名单长度；测试多种信息设计干预，包括披露承运商每日剩余运力、供应商多元化、名单顺序随机化、热度展示，以及展示真实质量而非估计评分。
brief.findings: 三个风险：第一，智能体第一天就收敛，同一个承运商成为所有模型的首选众数，吸引高达 76% 的请求；第二，候选名单超过约 10 家承运商后集中度陡升，且不同模型的临界点不同；第三，哪个承运商最终占主导在不同采样市场间差异很大，展示真实质量也不改变集中度水平和这种变异性。一个有效的补救措施：披露每家承运商的每日剩余运力，使集中度下降三分之一，货主剩余翻倍；供应商多元化、名单顺序随机化和热度展示没有可检测的效果。
brief.validation: 未说明材料中的具体验证方式；结果基于不同 LLM 模型和多个采样承运商群体的对比，但未提及与真实市场数据或人类基线的对比。
brief.limits: 按设计，质量只影响智能体所见，不影响交付结果，因此结论限于选择行为层面；不同模型集中度起始点不同，结果可能依赖所用模型；未说明其他局限。
brief.reuse: 平台信息设计思路可直接借鉴：披露承运商剩余运力这一干预在仿真中有效，可作为平台设计参考；未说明是否提供代码或数据。

f0ddcf45ea76dfc5.text: Urban mobility modeling faces challenges in representing decision-making in dynamic environments. Although Multi-Agent Systems are widely used, rule-based approaches rely on fixed heuristics that limit adaptive behavior. This work investigates the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) as decision-making components in multi-agent simulations. We propose a hybrid architecture that connects the GAMA platform to an external LLM-based module through an API, enabling agents to determine whether route replanning is necessary. Rather than replacing routing algorithms, the LLM serves as a decision layer that guides replanning behavior. The approach incorporates persistent memory, allowing past interactions to influence future decisions and promote behavioral consistency. We compare rule-based and LLM-assisted approaches across multiple road-blockage scenarios and population scales. Results indicate that LLM-enabled agents exhibit greater adaptability and contextual awareness, particularly in scenarios with higher route flexibility. Memory influences performance and behavioral consistency, with effects varying across configurations. Overall, LLMs serve as complementary cognitive layers that enrich behavioral representations in urban mobility simulations and hold potential for modeling complex decision-making in spatial multi-agent systems.

f1372273c736b789.text: LLMs agents are increasingly used in multi-agent settings, yet their behaviour in sustainability games remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether lying can emerge among LLM agents in a competitive sustainability game in which agents are informed that common resources can regenerate, although regeneration does not actually occur. We develop an agent-based model of a sustainability game in which agents manage industrial, military, and ecological resources, and interact through a network. LLM agents can observe neighbours' status, declare future attacks, receive permission to lie, and access reputation information, while rule-based agents provide an interpretable behavioural baseline. The results show that neighbour information strongly changes system dynamics, increasing attacks while improving biosphere retention and coexistence. Also, the presence of future declarations reduce extinction risk without suppressing conflict. Behaviourally, deception emerges even when agents are not explicitly allowed to lie, and explicit permission mainly increases bluffing and diversion rather than direct backstabbing. Finally, the presence of reputation memory and information about the current biosphere level reduces system ecological depletion. These findings suggest that deception can arise as an emergent behaviour in LLM-agent systems and that communication between LLM-agents could support sustainability while dealing with risk.
f1372273c736b789.abstract_zh:
LLM 智能体越来越多地用在多智能体环境里，但它们在可持续性博弈中的行为还很少有人研究。作者关心的问题是：说谎会不会在 LLM 智能体之间自发出现？

他们做了一个基于智能体的可持续性博弈模型：智能体管理工业、军事和生态三类资源，通过网络相互交互。LLM 智能体可以观察邻居的状态、提前宣告未来的攻击、获得说谎许可、访问声誉信息；同时用规则智能体作为可解释的行为基线。博弈设定里，智能体被告知公共资源可以再生，但实际上再生并不会发生。

结果方面，邻居信息强烈改变了系统动态，攻击增多，但生物圈保留率和共存情况反而改善。未来攻击宣告降低了灭绝风险，同时没有消除冲突。行为上，即使没有明确允许说谎，欺骗也会出现；明确许可主要带来虚张声势和转移话题，而不是直接背叛。此外，声誉记忆和当前生物圈水平的信息减少了系统的生态损耗。

这些发现说明，欺骗可以作为 LLM 智能体系统的涌现行为出现，而 LLM 智能体之间的通信有可能在应对风险的同时支持可持续性。
f1372273c736b789.why: 它给出了一个少见的反直觉结果：LLM 智能体不需要被允许说谎就会自发欺骗，而且邻居信息和攻击宣告这类通信机制反而改善生态保留，对设计多智能体仿真和评估 LLM 行为可信度都有参考价值。

fc1180f0851654b3.text: LLM-agent simulation faces a joint grounding and scaling problem: agents should act in environments that reflect real urban constraints, yet direct online LLM calls for city-scale populations are computationally prohibitive. We present GenWorld, an empirically grounded urban simulation infrastructure that combines a building-level synthetic city, a structured agent-environment interface, and offline compilation of LLM-derived decision signals into lookup policies for scalable rollout. In a reference instantiation for Higashihiroshima, Japan, GenWorld grounds 196,608 synthetic residents in census and geospatial data, validates demographic consistency against census tabulations, and uses YJMob100K mobile-phone data as a commuting-distance diagnostic. We demonstrate the infrastructure through three reproducible cases: a full-city weekday rollout, a weekday-weekend behavioral contrast, and a warning-response perturbation with auditable replanning traces. These cases support GenWorld as a reproducible platform for grounded and scalable LLM-agent studies, while calibrated forecasting for traffic, evacuation, or policy outcomes remains future work.
fc1180f0851654b3.abstract_zh:
LLM 智能体仿真面临接地与扩展的双重难题：智能体应当在反映真实城市约束的环境中行动，但城市规模人口的在线 LLM 调用在算力上不可行。GenWorld 是一套经验接地的城市仿真基础设施，包含三个部分：建筑级合成城市、结构化的智能体环境接口，以及把 LLM 推导的决策信号离线编译成查表策略，从而实现可扩展的推演。

在东广岛市的参考实例中，GenWorld 用人口普查和地理空间数据接地了 196,608 名合成居民，对照普查表格验证了人口统计一致性，并用 YJMob100K 手机数据作为通勤距离的诊断。作者用三个可复现案例展示这套基础设施：全城工作日推演、工作日与周末的行为对比，以及一次警告响应扰动实验，后者带有可审计的重新规划轨迹。

这些案例表明 GenWorld 可以作为接地且可扩展的 LLM 智能体研究的可复现平台。作者也明确指出，对交通、疏散或政策结果的校准预测仍是未来工作。
fc1180f0851654b3.why: 它给出了把 LLM 决策信号离线编译成查表策略来解决城市规模算力问题的具体方案，并附带真实城市数据校验和可复现案例，是做城市仿真基础设施可直接参考的工程路径。

brief.question: 解决 LLM 智能体城市仿真的两个难题：环境要贴合真实城市约束（grounding），同时城市规模人口的在线 LLM 调用算力开销过大（scaling）。
brief.setup: 以日本 Higashihiroshima 为参考实例，构建建筑级合成城市，放入 196,608 个合成居民，人口属性基于 census 和地理空间数据生成。未说明具体使用的 LLM 型号和时间尺度细节。
brief.method: GenWorld 把三部分组合起来：建筑级合成城市、结构化的 agent-environment 接口，以及把 LLM 产生的决策信号离线编译成 lookup policy，用于可扩展的 rollout，避免在线调用。
brief.findings: 用三个可复现案例演示：全城工作日 rollout、工作日与周末的行为对比、以及带可审计重规划轨迹的 warning-response 扰动实验。合成人口的人口学一致性与 census 汇总表核对。
brief.validation: 与 census 汇总表对比验证人口学一致性，并用 YJMob100K 手机数据作为通勤距离诊断。未说明具体误差数字。
brief.limits: 作者自己指出，对交通、疏散或政策结果的校准预测仍是未来工作。
brief.reuse: GenWorld 作为可复现平台发布，三个案例均可复现；未说明代码和数据的具体获取方式。

fb4e465d56d30de8.text: Current approaches to instill prosociality in large language model (LLM) agents often rely on humans specifying desired behaviors at the individual level, which does not guarantee cooperation within LLM populations. As frontier training shifts toward individual rewards for verifiable tasks, such as mathematics and coding, this outcome-based focus may further undermine cooperation in multi-agent settings. Large-scale cooperation in human populations emerged via unguided evolutionary mechanisms, not a central architect. Group selection, in which cooperative groups within a population outcompete less cooperative ones, has been argued to be essential. In this study, we explore whether group selection can promote cooperation in populations of LLM agents. We introduce a multi-agent simulation framework in which LLM agents play a repeated social dilemma game and transmit their natural-language prompts across generations under either individual- or group-level selection. Under group selection, prompts from high-performing groups are transmitted, thereby promoting prosociality and stabilizing cooperation. Under individual selection, self-interested prompts dominate, causing populations to collapse into collective defection. This gap is robust across prompt ablations, alternative game framings, and model swaps. We theoretically reproduce key results using a replicator-mutator model, whose empirical transmission kernel predicts a phase transition at a critical threshold. Preliminary findings show that, when informed about the selection mechanism, GPT-5.4 preemptively and gradually adjusts first-generation donations. This demonstrates strong anticipatory behavior that was not observed in the other tested models. These results demonstrate that prosocial prompts and cooperative behaviors evolve in LLM agent populations under group selection.
fb4e465d56d30de8.abstract_zh:
当前让 LLM 智能体变得亲社会的方法，通常靠人类在个体层面直接指定期望行为，这并不能保证 LLM 群体内部形成合作。而且前沿模型的训练越来越偏向数学、编程这类可验证任务上的个体奖励，这种以结果为导向的训练可能进一步削弱多智能体场景中的合作。人类群体的大规模合作是通过无引导的演化机制产生的，并没有一个中央设计者，其中群体选择被认为起了关键作用：合作程度高的群体在竞争中胜过合作程度低的群体。作者据此提出问题：群体选择能否在 LLM 智能体群体中促进合作？

他们搭建了一个多智能体仿真框架：LLM 智能体玩重复的社会困境博弈，并把各自的自然语言提示词跨代传递，传递规则分两种，个体层面的选择或群体层面的选择。在群体选择下，高绩效群体的提示词被传递下去，亲社会性得到促进，合作得以稳定；在个体选择下，自利的提示词占据主导，整个群体崩溃为集体背叛。这个差距在提示词消融、换用其他博弈框架、更换模型等多种条件下都保持稳健。作者还用复制者-变异者模型做了理论复现，从经验传输核预测出一个临界阈值处的相变。

初步发现还显示，当被告知选择机制时，GPT-5.4 会在第一代就预先、逐步调整捐赠水平，表现出其他测试模型都没有的强预期行为。整体结果表明，在群体选择下，亲社会提示词和合作行为可以在 LLM 智能体群体中演化出来。
fb4e465d56d30de8.why: 它把文化演化的群体选择机制引入 LLM 智能体仿真，给出了一条不靠人工指定行为、而是靠选择压力让合作自发涌现的路径，对设计多智能体协作仿真和提示词演化实验都有直接参考价值。

brief.question: 探讨在没有中央设计者逐个指定行为的情况下，能否通过群体选择（group selection）机制让 LLM 智能体群体自发演化出合作与亲社会行为，而不是依赖人类在个体层面规定亲社会行为。
brief.setup: 多智能体仿真框架，LLM 智能体反复进行社会困境博弈（repeated social dilemma game），并以自然语言 prompt 跨代传递；对比个体选择与群体选择两种传递方式。具体智能体数量、环境细节、时间尺度未说明。测试的模型包括 GPT-5.4 在内的多个模型，具体清单未说明。
brief.method: 群体选择下，表现好的群体的 prompt 被传递到下一代，从而促进亲社会 prompt 的扩散并稳定合作；个体选择下按个体表现传递 prompt。另用 replicator-mutator 模型做理论复现，其经验传输核预测在临界阈值处发生相变。
brief.findings: 群体选择下亲社会 prompt 和合作行为得以演化并稳定；个体选择下自利 prompt 占主导，群体塌缩为集体背叛。该差距在 prompt 消融、替代博弈框架和更换模型下均稳健。replicator-mutator 模型预测存在临界阈值处的相变。当被告知选择机制时，GPT-5.4 会在第一代就预先、逐步调整捐赠额，表现出其他测试模型没有的强预期行为。
brief.validation: 做了 prompt 消融、替代博弈框架和模型替换的稳健性检验；并用 replicator-mutator 理论模型复现关键结果，其经验传输核预测出临界阈值相变。未与真实人类群体数据对比。
brief.limits: GPT-5.4 的预期行为仅为初步发现（preliminary findings）；未说明具体智能体数量、时间尺度和模型清单；未与真实人类数据对比验证。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的是这个多智能体仿真框架本身：LLM 智能体玩重复社会困境博弈并以自然语言 prompt 跨代传递，可切换个体/群体选择；以及用 replicator-mutator 模型和经验传输核做理论分析的方法。代码和数据是否公开未说明。

f04285849dcf3cb2.text: Learning to simulate human users in interactive settings could advance the training of agent assistants, evaluation of personalization systems, research in the social sciences, and more. Existing approaches generally do so by training a large language model (LLM) to match a single ground truth response, either by maximizing the log probability or by using a similarity reward. We instead propose Turing-RL: a Turing-Test-based reinforcement learning approach for training user simulator models. Turing-RL uses a discriminative Turing reward with an LLM judge to score how indistinguishable a generated response is from the real user's given the user's history, and the user simulator LLM learns to produce responses indistinguishable from what the user could have said with such rewards. Across two different domains--conversational chat and Reddit forum discussion--we find that Turing-RL consistently outperforms baseline methods on both LLM and human evaluation metrics. Our study suggests that optimizing for indistinguishability, rather than response matching, is effective for learning user simulators.

fe5cb6db33c3c81b.text: Effective demand response in smart microgrids requires prosumers to cooperate voluntarily under strategic self-interest, a coordination problem structurally equivalent to a repeated Prisoner's Dilemma on a social network. This paper presents a multi-agent simulation in which a Large Language Model (LLM) Influence Compiler issues structured demand-response directives to a population of heterogeneous prosumer agents, each governed by a hybrid decision architecture combining game-theoretic base probability (derived from payoff history, neighbour imitation, and exploitation memory) with LLM narrative evaluation of incoming coordination signals. The hybrid architecture resolves a key methodological challenge: LLMs aligned via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) exhibit strong cooperation bias when used as direct decision-makers, producing flat dynamics regardless of grid conditions. By separating strategic reasoning from grounded narrative evaluation, the model generates realistic prosumer behaviour across six personality archetypes, with baseline cooperation near 50% and clear differentiation under influence. Compiled structured directives achieve 33.3% demand-curtailment cooperation versus 27.0% for unstructured messaging and 28.0% for a no-intervention baseline ($Δ_\mathrm{comp} = +0.063$), with the advantage preserved across both grounded and idealized agent substrates ($Δ= +0.083$) and across all resistance levels ($R = 0.1$ to $0.7$). Hub-targeted dissemination via high-centrality network nodes outperforms peripheral or random targeting, confirming that grid topology provides mechanistic amplification independent of message content. These results suggest that structured LLM compilation, grounded agent reasoning, and network-aware targeting are complementary design principles for scalable, interpretable demand-response coordination in smart-city energy systems.

f74e0826be73c7ed.text: General agentic intelligence hinges on the ability to interact with diverse real-world tools to complete complex tasks, a capability fundamentally tied to the quality of interaction data. To bypass the prohibitive costs of human annotation, prevailing paradigms depend entirely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to scale the synthesis of agentic environments and tasks. However, such unconstrained generation often degenerates into biased random sampling of LLMs' internal priors, failing to capture the diversity and difficulty of real-world domains or construct high-fidelity, long-horizon tasks. In this work, we introduce Grounded Agentic Interaction Synthesis (GAIS), a framework that automates the scalable construction of diverse environments and complex tasks via a two-phase grounding mechanism. Specifically, we construct protocol-anchored environments derived from real-world Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to ensure functional diversity and difficulty. Subsequently, we employ structure-guided planning to navigate these environments, actively enforcing logical dependencies and adversarial policies to generate complex tasks. Experiments on BFCL, $τ^2$-Bench, and ACEBench demonstrate that GAIS-synthesized data significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, enabling base models to match or even surpass their official instruction-tuned counterparts. Furthermore, GAIS exhibits superior data efficiency and scalability, achieving exceptional capabilities with significantly less data while maintaining continuous growth where baselines stagnate. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/Eric8932/GAIS.

f4d061b6e7a3a39c.text: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong capabilities in perception, reasoning, and action generation. However, their ability to sustain exploration in dynamic open worlds remains unclear. Existing embodied and game-based benchmarks often compress interaction into short-horizon tasks or entangle success with domain-specific game mechanics. In this paper, we introduce MineExplorer benchmark for evaluating open-world exploration capabilities of MLLM agents in Minecraft. We first filter atomic tasks whose solutions rely heavily on Minecraft-specific knowledge to better reflect general open-world reasoning. Then we organize the benchmark around a ReAct-style capability formulation and compose atomic tasks into implicit multi-hop tasks. To further construct reliable instances, MineExplorer uses a multi-agent synthesis workflow that jointly designs task graphs, sandbox scenes, and rule-based milestone evaluators. Human evaluation shows that the multi-agent synthesis workflow produces significantly more reliable instances than a single-agent baseline. Experiments with advanced MLLM agents show that open-world exploration remains challenging, as strong models can handle many single-hop tasks but degrade sharply when hidden prerequisites must be coordinated over longer trajectories. Further analysis finds that task difficulty tracks agent completion, and larger models or thinking modes do not consistently translate into better performance. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/meituan-longcat/MineExplorer.

f5b8bd6633451741.text: Taxation is a fundamental instrument of economic policy and has long been studied through economic models. However, most existing taxation models focus on interactions within a single economic group, typically with one government and multiple households. Such a setting overlooks interactions among independent economic groups, where governments may compete for economic resources through fiscal policies. To capture these interactions, we formulate taxation as a hierarchical multi-group tax game. Within each group, a government sets tax policies while households respond, forming a hierarchical government--household interaction. Across groups, governments compete through fiscal policies, coupling the economic dynamics of distinct groups. This coupled structure poses challenges for standard multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) methods. To this end, we propose Multi-Group PPO (MGPPO), a bilevel MARL algorithm designed for hierarchical multi-group interactions. MGPPO incorporates Hierarchical Sampling to coordinate learning across agent levels and Curriculum Learning to improve training stability. We further develop a multi-group taxation simulation environment grounded in classical economic models, supporting the evaluation of fiscal policies under inter-group competition. Simulations show that in the two-group settings, MGPPO reduces the income and wealth Gini coefficients by 5.0\% and 4.9\%, respectively, and increases mean GDP by 4.1\% compared with IPPO.

fd8a61e499074d67.text: Interactive, multi-agent social simulation systems have shown promise for helping users practice navigating various complex social situations across domains. This paper asks: To what extent can such systems help young adult (YA) bystanders speak up publicly against cyberbullying, a task often thwarted by complex, multi-party social dynamics? We created Upstanders' Practicum, a multi-AI-agent social media simulation powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), as a probe and observed 34 YAs freely practicing public bystander intervention across three iteratively refined versions. We found that practicing public bystander intervention in the simulation was helpful, but after participants made three attention shifts: (1) from inattention to paying true attention, (2) from self-focus ("I don't usually do this'') to attending to those directly involved, and (3) from resolving the private conflict between bully and victim ("maybe I could set up the meeting between them'') to addressing the broader audience online ("public comment is about norm-setting"). Only after these shifts did practice in the simulation start to help: participants then saw a reason to speak up publicly and, through continued practice, crafted tactful public messages without explicit instruction. These findings illuminate new design and research opportunities for bystander education beyond social skill instruction, namely, designing for true attention, for fostering a vocal upstander identity, and for seeing bystander intervention as public norm setting. In addition, we open-source Truman Agents (cornell-design-aigroup.github.io/TrumanAgents/), the first-of-its-kind multi-LLM-agent social media simulation platform that Upstanders' Practicum builds upon, for future cyberbullying and social media research.

f4dcc7503327c052.text: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, understanding how strategic behavior emerges in multi-agent environments has become an important alignment challenge. We take a neutral empirical stance and construct a controlled environment in which strategic behavior can be directly observed and measured. We introduce a large-scale multi-agent simulation in a simplified model of New York City, where LLM-driven agents interact under opposing incentives. Blue agents aim to reach their destinations efficiently, while Red agents attempt to divert them toward billboard-heavy routes using persuasive language to maximize advertising revenue. Hidden identities make navigation socially mediated, forcing agents to decide when to trust or deceive. We study policy learning through an iterative simulation pipeline that updates agent policies across repeated interaction rounds using Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO). Blue agents are optimized to reduce billboard exposure while preserving navigation efficiency, whereas Red agents adapt to exploit remaining weaknesses. Across iterations, the best Blue policy improves task success from 46.0% to 57.3%, although susceptibility remains high at 70.7%. Later policies exhibit stronger selective cooperation while preserving trajectory efficiency. However, a persistent safety-helpfulness trade-off remains: policies that better resist adversarial steering do not simultaneously maximize task completion. Overall, our results show that LLM agents can exhibit limited strategic behavior, including selective trust and deception, while remaining highly vulnerable to adversarial persuasion.
f4dcc7503327c052.abstract_zh:
随着 LLM 越来越多地被部署为自主智能体，策略行为如何在多智能体环境中出现，成了一个对齐层面的重要问题。作者采取中立的实证立场，构建了一个可以直接观察和测量策略行为的受控环境：一个简化纽约城模型中的大规模多智能体仿真。蓝方智能体目标是高效到达目的地，红方智能体则用说服性语言把蓝方引向广告牌密集的路线，以最大化广告收入。所有智能体身份隐藏，导航因此变成社会中介的过程，每个智能体都要决定何时信任、何时欺骗。

策略学习通过一个迭代仿真管线完成，每轮交互后用 Kahneman-Tversky Optimization（KTO）更新智能体策略。蓝方被优化为减少广告牌暴露同时保持导航效率，红方则适应性地利用蓝方残留的弱点。跨迭代来看，最优蓝方策略把任务成功率从 46.0% 提升到 57.3%，但易受诱导的比例仍高达 70.7%。后期策略表现出更强的选择性合作，同时保持了轨迹效率。

不过一个持续存在的安全性与有用性的权衡没有消除：更能抵抗对抗性引导的策略，并不能同时把任务完成度做到最高。总体结论是，LLM 智能体可以表现出有限的策略行为，包括选择性信任和欺骗，但在对抗性说服面前仍然非常脆弱。
f4dcc7503327c052.why: 它提供了一个可复用的对抗性社会仿真范式：隐藏身份、红蓝激励对立、KTO 迭代优化策略，直接量化了 LLM 智能体在信任与欺骗上的能力上限和脆弱性，对研究智能体对齐和对抗鲁棒性的人是难得的实证数据点。

brief.question: LLM 智能体在多智能体环境中能否学会策略性行为（选择性信任与欺骗），以及对抗性说服下导航任务的安全性问题。
brief.setup: 在简化的 New York City 模型中运行大规模多智能体仿真。Blue agents 目标是高效到达目的地，Red agents 用说服性语言把 Blue 引向广告牌密集路线以最大化广告收入，双方身份隐藏。策略学习通过迭代仿真管线完成，用 Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO) 跨多轮交互更新策略。
brief.method: 迭代仿真管线：每轮交互后用 KTO 更新策略，Blue agents 优化为减少广告牌暴露同时保持导航效率，Red agents 则适应性地利用剩余弱点。隐藏身份使导航变成社会中介过程，智能体必须决定何时信任或欺骗。
brief.findings: 最优 Blue 策略把任务成功率从 46.0% 提升到 57.3%，但对说服的易感性仍高达 70.7%。后期策略表现出更强的选择性合作，同时保持轨迹效率。存在持续的安全-有用性权衡：更能抵抗对抗性引导的策略并不能同时最大化任务完成率。
brief.validation: 未说明（材料未提及与真实数据或人类基线的对比，也未提及消融实验）。
brief.limits: 作者自述存在持续的安全-有用性权衡，且智能体对对抗性说服仍然高度脆弱（易感性 70.7%），策略性行为有限。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的包括：简化的 NYC 多智能体仿真环境设定、隐藏身份的对抗交互机制、以及用 KTO 做迭代策略更新的管线。代码和数据未说明。

f24a9191a04f6a66.text: Human mobility modeling is indispensable for diverse urban applications. However, existing data-driven methods often suffer from data scarcity, limiting their applicability in regions where historical trajectories are unavailable or restricted. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{ActivityEditor}, a novel dual-LLM-agent framework designed for zero-shot cross-regional trajectory generation. Our framework decomposes the complex synthesis task into two collaborative stages. Specifically, an intention-based agent, which leverages demographic-driven priors to generate structured human intentions and coarse activity chains to ensure high-level socio-semantic coherence. These outputs are then refined by editor agent to obtain mobility trajectories through iteratively revisions that enforces human mobility law. This capability is acquired through reinforcement learning with multiple rewards grounded in real-world physical constraints, allowing the agent to internalize mobility regularities and ensure high-fidelity trajectory generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textbf{ActivityEditor} achieves superior zero-shot performance when transferred across diverse urban contexts. It maintains high statistical fidelity and physical validity, providing a robust and highly generalizable solution for mobility simulation in data-scarce scenarios. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ActivityEditor-066B.

fd7af38072f26e9a.text: Creating scalable and believable game societies requires balancing authorial control with computational cost. Existing scripted NPC systems scale efficiently but are often rigid, whereas fully LLM-driven agents can produce richer social behavior at a much higher runtime cost. We present CASCADE, a three-layer architecture for low-cost, controllable social coordination in sandbox-style game worlds. A Macro State Director (Level 1) maintains discrete-time world-state variables and macro-level causal updates, while a modular Coordination Hub decomposes state changes through domain-specific components (e.g., professional and social coordination) and routes the resulting directives to tag-defined groups. Then Tag-Driven NPCs (Level 3) execute responses through behavior trees and local state/utility functions, invoking large language models only for on-demand player-facing interactions. We evaluate CASCADE through multiple micro-scenario prototypes and trace-based analysis, showing how a shared macro event can produce differentiated yet logically constrained NPC behaviors without per-agent prompting in the main simulation loop. CASCADE provides a modular foundation for scalable social simulation and future open-world authoring tools.
fd7af38072f26e9a.abstract_zh: 做可扩展又可信的游戏社会，要在作者控制力和计算成本之间找平衡。现有脚本化 NPC 系统扩展效率高但行为僵硬，全用大模型驱动的智能体能产生更丰富的社会行为，运行时成本却高得多。CASCADE 针对这个问题提出三层架构。第一层是宏观状态主管，维护离散时间的世界状态变量，并做宏观层面的因果更新。第二层是模块化的协调中枢，把状态变化拆给领域特定组件（如职业协调、社交协调），再把产生的指令路由给按标签定义的群体。第三层是标签驱动的 NPC，通过行为树和本地状态与效用函数执行响应，只在需要面向玩家的按需交互时才调用大语言模型。作者用多个微场景原型和基于轨迹的分析做了评估，展示了一个共享的宏观事件如何在不逐个智能体提示主循环的情况下，产生有差异但受逻辑约束的 NPC 行为。作者认为 CASCADE 为可扩展社会仿真和未来的开放世界创作工具提供了模块化基础。验证只停留在原型场景和轨迹分析层面，没有与真实数据或真人实验对照。
fd7af38072f26e9a.why: 它给“大模型智能体仿真太贵”这个普遍痛点提供了一个可复用的工程方案：把大模型调用压缩到玩家交互环节，社会协调交给宏观状态层和行为树，做大规模沙盒仿真或游戏 NPC 的研究者可以直接借鉴这套分层思路。

f124886f790e661d.text: The growing deployment of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUASs) in low-altitude airspaces has increased the need for reliable tactical deconfliction under safety-critical constraints. Tactical deconfliction involves short-horizon decision-making in dense, partially observable, and heterogeneous multi-agent environments, where both cooperative separation assurance and operational efficiency must be maintained. While Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, their direct application to air traffic control remains limited by insufficient domain grounding and unpredictable output inconsistency. This paper investigates LLMs as decision-makers in cooperative multi-agent tactical deconfliction using fine-tuning strategies that align model outputs to human operator heuristics. We propose a simulation-to-language data generation pipeline based on the BlueSky air traffic simulator that produces rule-consistent deconfliction datasets reflecting established safety practices. A pretrained Qwen-Math-7B model is fine-tuned using two parameter-efficient strategies: supervised fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and preference-based fine-tuning combining LoRA with Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experimental results on validation datasets and closed-loop simulations demonstrate that supervised LoRA fine-tuning substantially improves decision accuracy, consistency, and separation performance compared to the pretrained LLM, with significant reductions in near mid-air collisions. GRPO provides additional coordination benefits but exhibits reduced robustness when interacting with heterogeneous agent policies.

f89e61b266b78ea2.text: High-fidelity social simulation is pivotal for addressing complex Web societal challenges, yet it demands agents capable of authentically replicating the dynamic spectrum of human interaction. Current LLM-based multi-agent frameworks, however, predominantly adhere to static interaction topologies, failing to capture the fluid oscillation between cooperative knowledge synthesis and competitive critical reasoning seen in real-world scenarios. This rigidity often leads to unrealistic ``groupthink'' or unproductive deadlocks, undermining the credibility of simulations for decision support. To bridge this gap, we propose \textit{BEACOF}, a \textit{belief-driven adaptive collaboration framework} inspired by Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium (PBE). By modeling social interaction as a dynamic game of incomplete information, BEACOF rigorously addresses the circular dependency between collaboration type selection and capability estimation. Agents iteratively refine probabilistic beliefs about peer capabilities and autonomously modulate their collaboration strategy, thereby ensuring sequentially rational decisions under uncertainty. Validated across adversarial (judicial), open-ended (social) and mixed (medical) scenarios, BEACOF prevents coordination failures and fosters robust convergence toward high-quality solutions, demonstrating superior potential for reliable social simulation. Source codes and datasets are publicly released at: https://github.com/WUT-IDEA/BEACOF.

f75b26067d3e8b16.text: Using persona-conditioned LLMs as synthetic survey respondents has become a common practice in computational social science and agent-based simulations. Yet, it remains unclear whether multi-attribute persona prompting improves LLM reliability or instead introduces distortions. Here we contribute to this assessment by leveraging a large dataset of U.S. microdata from the World Values Survey. Concretely, we evaluate two open-weight chat models and a random-guesser baseline across more than 70K respondent-item instances. We find that persona prompting does not yield a clear aggregate improvement in survey alignment and, in many cases, significantly degrades performance. Persona effects are highly heterogeneous as most items exhibit minimal change, while a small subset of questions and underrepresented subgroups experience disproportionate distortions. Our findings highlight a key adverse impact of current persona-based simulation practices: demographic conditioning can redistribute error in ways that undermine subgroup fidelity and risk misleading downstream analyses.
f75b26067d3e8b16.abstract_zh: 在计算社会科学和智能体仿真里，给大模型加上人口学人格设定（persona prompting），让它扮演特定背景的调查受访者，已经是常见做法。但这样做究竟提升了模型回答与真人调查数据的吻合度，还是引入了新的偏差，此前并不清楚。这项研究用世界价值观调查（World Values Survey）的美国微数据来回答这个问题。作者评估了两个开放权重的对话模型和一个随机猜测基线，覆盖超过 7 万个受访者-题目实例。结论是人格提示在总体层面没有带来清晰的调查对齐提升，很多情况下还显著降低了表现。人格提示的影响高度不均匀，大多数题目变化很小，但一小部分题目和代表性不足的子群体出现了不成比例的扭曲。作者指出，当前基于人格的仿真做法有一个关键隐患，人口学条件化会重新分配误差，损害子群体的保真度，可能误导下游分析。局限在于材料未说明两个模型的具体名称和实验细节。
f75b26067d3e8b16.why: 它用大规模真实调查数据直接检验了仿真领域广泛使用的人格提示做法，给出的是一个反例结论，任何用 LLM 合成受访者或做人群仿真的研究者都需要正视这个误差再分配风险。

brief.question: 检验 persona-conditioned LLM 作为合成调查受访者是否可靠，多属性 persona prompting 到底提升还是损害 LLM 与真实调查数据的对齐度。
brief.setup: 用 World Values Survey 的美国微观数据做基准，评估两个开源权重 chat 模型和一个随机猜测基线，覆盖超过 70K 个受访者-条目实例。
brief.method: 给 LLM 施加多属性人口统计 persona 条件，将其回答与真实 WVS 调查数据对齐比较，并区分总体效应与逐条目、逐子群体的效应。
brief.findings: persona prompting 在总体上没有带来明确的调查对齐提升，很多情况下显著降低表现。效应高度异质：多数条目变化很小，少数问题和代表性不足的子群体承受了不成比例的失真。人口统计条件化会重新分配误差，损害子群体保真度。
